attributes.name: Druva - Recovery Paused or Suspended
attributes.description: Detects a Druva restore or recovery operation that is paused or suspended.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects a Druva restore or recovery operation that is paused or suspended.

attributes.query:
(
  message:*recover*
  or message:*restore*
  or druva.event_type:*Recover*
  or druva.event_type:*Restore*
)
and (
  message:*paused*
  or message:*suspended*
  or event.outcome:("Paused" or "Suspended")
  or event.outcome:("Paused" or "Suspended")
)
